notes:
Originally a technical term from materials science for the size of particles or grains. Now widely used in IT, business, and project management to describe how finely something is broken down or specified.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粒度|りゅうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧／⟦{粗|あら}い→粗い：00439_arai⟧ — fine / coarse granularity
- {粒度|りゅうど}⟦{分布|ぶんぷ}→分布：00021_bunpu⟧ — grain size distribution
- {粒度|りゅうど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧ — to align the level of detail
- {粒度|りゅうど}⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧ — grain size analysis; granularity analysis

USAGE:
In business and IT contexts, {粒度|りゅうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧ means highly detailed (fine-grained), and {粒度|りゅうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{粗|あら}い→粗い：00439_arai⟧ means broad or high-level (coarse-grained). This figurative extension is very productive in modern Japanese workplace communication.
